snippet.title: DAMON and BABY - Pre-Order Trailer
snippet.description:
Top-Down Gun Action-Adventure DAMON and BABY—The Journey of a Demon Lord and a Mysterious Child—Pre-orders Open Today!

Deluxe Edition Featuring Digital Artwork & Soundtrack Announced! Steam Playable Demo Available February 20!

Pre-orders for both the Standard and Deluxe Editions have begun on all platform stores. Early Purchase Bonus: A 10% discount applies to pre-orders/early purchases across all platforms.

[Store Links]
Nintendo eShop: https://bit.ly/DamonandBabySwitch
PlayStation Store: https://bit.ly/DamonandBabyPlaystation
PlayStation® Exclusive: Pre-ordering the Deluxe Edition on PS5® or PS4® includes 24-hour Early Access.
Steam Store: https://bit.ly/DamonandBabySteam

PlayStation® Exclusive: Pre-ordering the Deluxe Edition on PS5® or PS4® includes 24-hour Early Access.

We are excited to reveal that the Deluxe Edition will launch on Thursday, March 26, 2026, and a Steam Playable Demo will be available starting February 20.

DAMON and BABY is an action-adventure game featuring the Demon Lord "Damon," who is entrusted with a "mysterious child" following the last request of his late best friend. Together, they embark on a journey to break a curse in this high-octane, top-down shooter.

----------------------

The DAMON and BABY Steam Playable Demo is scheduled for release on February 20, 2026. Additionally, we have confirmed our participation in the "Steam Next Fest" (February 2026), a festival showcasing new titles from around the world. We look forward to your feedback and reviews to help us refine the final release. 

Note: Demos for PS5, PS4, and Nintendo Switch are planned for a later date.

[Steam Demo Overview]
Period: Feb 20, 1:00 AM (UTC) – March 3, 2:00 AM (UTC), 2026
Platform: Steam
Want to join?
Download the demo via the Steam Store page!
